movelist.name: Psychic
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 1 meter in any direction. Psychic lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Heal Block
movelist.effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target may not gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points from any source. This effect ends if the target is switched out or Takes a Breather.

movelist.name: Future Sight
movelist.effect: Future Sight does nothing on the turn it is used. At the end of the user’s next turn, Future Sight hits, even if the user is no longer on the field. Future Sight cannot miss.

movelist.name: Flatter
movelist.effect: The target’s Special Attack is raised by +1 Combat Stage. Flatter Confuses the target.

movelist.name: Psyshock
movelist.effect: When calculating damage, the target subtracts their Defense from Psyshock’s damage instead of their Special Defense. Psyshock is still otherwise Special ( Special Evasion is used to avoid it, Mirror Coat can reflect it, etc. )

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls against adjacent targets.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. Whenever an Ally uses a damaging area-of-effect attack that would hit you, you may Disengage as a Free Action before the attack resolves.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.effect: The target’s shadow becomes pinned to the target’s current spot for 5 turns. During this time, the target is Slowed and Trapped, and cannot move more than 5 meters from the spot their shadow is pinned to; even being Pushed and other forced movement effects cannot force the target to Move more than 5 meters from that spot.
